summary: Checks test and vet pass and the revision fast-forwards origin/master, but the startup discovery path starts two refresh loops per auto-discovered instance. main now calls app.syncDiscoveredInstances before app.Start; syncDiscoveredInstances starts a refreshLoop for each added instance (app.go step 4), then Start starts another refreshLoop for the same worker over the now-merged inventory. This was verified with a temporary in-package test: a startup-discovered instance reached max concurrent collectors=2 (want 1), violating the documented one-worker/no-overlap invariant. The duplicate loop also breaks cleanup: worker.cancel() cancels only the sync-created child context, so after syncDiscoveredInstances(nil) prunes the instance, the Start-created loop keeps polling it and refreshOnce recreates its state (verified collector calls increased after cleanup and the state reappeared). Fix by ensuring exactly one worker is launched for startup-discovered instances (for example, let Start own all worker startup, or do not start workers inside the pre-Start sync call).
